evidence.api_compatibility: No API changes. This is a documentation-only PR — deleting an internal spec file, adding a published section to the custom model guide, and updating cross-references in the FAQ, configuration reference, and embeddable guide.
evidence.documentation: Excellent. The PR consolidates a drifted internal spec (src/cpp/Extra-Models-Dir-Spec.md, which documented a --extra-models-dir flag that no longer exists) into a comprehensive published section in docs/guide/configuration/custom-models.md. It adds a rules table, an examples table with one row per interpretation, and notes for both non-HF/MS folders and HF/MS caches. It removes redundant rules restated in docs/embeddable/models.md (six partial rules copied verbatim, which the author notes is worse than a pointer). It updates cross-references in the FAQ, the configuration reference README, and the embeddable guide. The FAQ drops stale llama.cpp cache paths and replaces them with LM Studio and Hugging Face cache paths.
evidence.manual_release_testing: This commit ships only documentation. The new Imported models section in docs/guide/configuration/custom-models.md describes the behavior, but the behavior itself is implemented by other commits in the stack. No user-reachable code changes or new surfaces introduced by this commit.
evidence.post_approval_commits: One commit (9786cd6ac20a2373c0830ad498fd2d0489054368) was added after the first approval (@fl0rianr) but before the second approval (@anditherobot). It adds a single sentence and a horizontal rule to confirm that reserved-directory folder IDs like extra.embeddings still work after the directory is reserved. This is a documentation clarification consistent with an existing test (test_reserved_directory_keeps_folder_id) and directly implements @anditherobot's inline suggestion. No post-approval commits after the final approval.
evidence.review: The PR was opened by @jeremyfowers and received detailed inline review from @fl0rianr (6+ review comments across naming rules, HF/MS cache detection, and conflict resolution) and hands-on testing from @anditherobot (tested LM Studio folder format with three publishers and two quants each, caught a missing note about reserved-directory folder-id preservation, and suggested the exact replacement text). @fl0rianr has subject area expertise in CI and GUI; @anditherobot reviewed the documentation with real-world scenarios. The first approval came from @fl0rianr on 2026-09-23T15:20:48Z. One commit (9786cd6) was added after first approval but before the second approval — it added a single sentence confirming that the folder's old name (e.g. extra.embeddings) still works, which directly implements @anditherobot's inline suggestion. The final approval from @anditherobot came on 2026-09-24T20:51:37Z with no further changes. No post-approval churn.
evidence.security: No security concerns. The commit removes an old spec file and adds documentation. No credential handling, network calls, code execution paths, or supply-chain changes.
evidence.tests: This is a documentation-only PR — no code, no tests. The author notes that naming examples were run against a live server. The spec file deletion (src/cpp/Extra-Models-Dir-Spec.md) removes outdated documentation that referenced a --extra-models-dir flag that no longer exists.
